metadata.description: Export dsh-token-audit JSON summaries as OTLP/JSON metrics.
metadata.name: dsh-otel

paragraphs.text: Export dsh-token-audit JSON summaries as OTLP/JSON metrics.

> DSH has cost dashboards, but no machine-readable export. This turns a `dsh-token-audit` JSON
> sum
mary into OTLP/JSON **metrics** for Grafana, Langfuse, or any collector that accepts JSON.

It is a **summary** exporter: cost, tokens, sessions, calls, projected monthly, idle/peak, and
per-m
odel totals. It does not produce per-turn or per-tool spans.

- No network: it writes JSON; your collector uploads it.
- No per-turn/per-tool spans, no live strea

ming, no dashboard.
- It inherits the audit's pricing; it does not re-price.
- Redact the audit befo

re exporting if titles/paths are sensitive.
- OTLP/JSON only, not protobuf.

Inspired by claude-code-otel; no source copied.
See `NOTICE.md`. License: MIT.
